class.name: OcgBrepfeatMakecylindricalhole
class.brief_description: Provides a tool to make cylindrical holes on a shape.
class.description: ! Provides a tool to make cylindrical holes on a shape.

method.name: Init_1
method.description: Sets the axis of the hole(s).

method.name: Init_2
method.description: Sets the shape and axis on which hole(s) will be performed.

method.name: Perform_1
method.description: Performs every hole of radius <Radius>. This command has the same effect as a cut operation with an infinite cylinder defined by the given axis and <Radius>.

method.name: Perform_2
method.description: Performs every hole of radius <Radius> located between PFrom and PTo on the given axis. If <WithControl> is set to Standard_False no control are done on the resulting shape after the operation is performed.

method.name: PerformThruNext
method.description: Performs the first hole of radius <Radius>, in the direction of the defined axis. First hole signify first encountered after the origin of the axis. If <WithControl> is set to Standard_False no control are done on the resulting shape after the operation is performed.

method.name: PerformUntilEnd
method.description: Performs every hole of radius <Radius> located after the origin of the given axis. If <WithControl> is set to Standard_False no control are done on the resulting shape after the operation is performed.

method.name: PerformBlind
method.description: Performs a blind hole of radius <Radius> and length <Length>. The length is measured from the origin of the given axis. If <WithControl> is set to Standard_False no control are done after the operation is performed.

method.name: Status
method.description: Returns the status after a hole is performed.

method.name: Build
method.description: Builds the resulting shape (redefined from MakeShape). Invalidates the given parts of tools if any, and performs the result of the local operation.
